---
title: "Session 19 — Naive vs adjusted aid OLS"
author: "Prof. Dae-Jin Lee (daelee@faculty.ie.edu)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
aid <- read_csv("data/aid_observational.csv")
```

```{r}
m1 <- lm(economic_growth_pct ~ aid_per_capita, data = aid)
m2 <- lm(
  economic_growth_pct ~ aid_per_capita +
    baseline_need + conflict_intensity + institutional_quality,
  data = aid
)

summary(m1)
summary(m2)

coef(m1)["aid_per_capita"]
coef(m2)["aid_per_capita"]
```

**Write:** What changed? Which assumptions remain? Name one bad-control risk you did *not* include.
